ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) medial regions to high-intensity (white/cream) distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region extending from peduncle to notch; high-intensity pigmentation concentrated on the distal terminal tips of both lobes; numerous small circular high-intensity pockmarks clustered in the dark medial zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees; depth is minimal relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct deep indentation (notch) located approximately mid-way along the trailing edge of the right lobe; jagged terminal tip on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges tapering to acute distal points; trailing edges exhibit a multi-segmented linear trajectory towards the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (pockmarks) distributed across the dark medial surface; dense cluster of calcified-appearing material (barnacle remnants) on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, roughly parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the high-intensity region of the right lobe; faint diagonal linear scratches on the medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical white linear scar located at the central base near the peduncle junction; significant tissue loss or irregular growth on the far left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique semi-circular white mark located near the upper-center of the right lobe, distinct from typical pockmarks.
